title: Nowe wzory struktur JPK_VAT dostępne na ePUAP
content:
Source list scan draft.

Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - aktualności VAT/JPK/KSeF
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/aktualnosci/nowe-wzory-struktur-jpk_vat-dostepne-na-epuap

Summary:
- The page announces updated JPK_VAT structure templates now available on ePUAP. This relates to VAT JPK (JPK_VAT) reporting requirements for taxpayers in Poland and provides access to the new formats via the tax authority portal.
- It sits under the “Aktualności” (News) section and is part of the broader Tax Service portal, which also offers guides, online services, and tools for individuals and businesses.
- If you need the latest VAT JPK_VAT templates for 2026 specifically, this page indicates that updated forms/templates are now released and accessible through ePUAP for electronic submission.
Note: The page listing provided highlights indicates broader sections (PIT/CIT/VAT/JPK, etc.) but does not show direct links to the 2026 VAT JPK templates. For precise download or submission steps, visit the Polish Ministry of Finance/tax portal’s Aktualności or ePUAP sections and se...
